fusions.name: Sudden Venom
fusions.desc: Spits a stinger of venom that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and makes it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Croaking Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a wide cone of water ahead of you, dealing 7 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Holds up to 3 charges, and each kill gives one back. Stingers fight beside you for 6 seconds, striking for 2 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gone Before Noticed
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 5 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Fresh Legs
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, a stinger springs at the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 8 damage and making it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
